title: Multiplying test forms by a smooth function supported in W is a linear map D^q(V) → D^q(W)
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ, let V, W ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets, and let χ : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ) with tsupport χ ⊆ W. Then there is an ℝ-linear map L : D^q(V) → D^q(W) (TestFormOn V q →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn W q) such that (Lω)(x) = χ(x)·ω(x) for every ω ∈ D^q(V) and every x ∈ ℝ^P. This is an identity of underlying forms; χ(x)·ω(x) is the scalar multiple of the covector ω(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (V W : Set (Eucl P)) (χ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ → tsupport χ ⊆ W → ∃ L : TestFormOn V q →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn W q, ∀ (ω : TestFormOn V q) (x : Eucl P), (L ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x = χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x
